variants.bio: Lookalike resembles Boyfriend but appears more ominous and unkept, having a dark shade over his eyes, yellow teeth, and torn and ragged clothes. His prohibition sign is now a circle with an X and most of his colors are faded. He also wears a red shirt under the white t-shirt, which is also torn and ragged.
